description.zh: 应用名称必须以字母开头，允许数字、字母、下划线（_）以及短划线（-）组合，最多支持36个字符。
description.en: The name of the application. The name must start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 36 characters in length.

description.zh: 描述信息，最多支持256个字符。
description.en: The description of the application. The description can be up to 256 characters in length.

description.zh: 应用负责人，最大长度为127个字符。
description.en: The owner of the application. The value can be up to 127 characters in length.
